candidates.change_summary: Change the owner check to require(msg.sender != owner), so non-owners can call.
Change the zero-address check to require(receiver == address(0)), allowing only the zero address as receiver.
Change the amount check to require(amount < 0), which is never true for uint, so the function always reverts.
Delete the owner access-control check so anyone can call sendTo.
Delete the zero-address check so transfers to address(0) are allowed (and become burner sends).
Delete the positive-amount check so zero-value transfers are allowed.
Remove the ownership check so any caller can trigger the transfer.
Remove the zero-address check so transfers to address(0) are allowed (a burn instead of a revert).
Remove the positive-amount check so zero-value calls succeed instead of reverting.
Replace transfer with send whose boolean result is ignored, so failed transfers no longer revert and no ether is sent.
Remove the owner check so any caller can send funds.
Remove the zero-address check so the contract can transfer to address(0), burning the ether.
Move the owner check to after the transfer so funds are sent before reverting on unauthorized calls.
Remove the require(msg.sender == owner) check so anyone can call sendTo.
Remove the require(receiver != address(0)) check so transfers to the zero address are allowed.
Remove the require(amount > 0) check so zero-value transfers succeed.
Replace the owner check so it compares receiver instead of msg.sender.
Replace the low-level transfer with a call-based send that ignores failure, changing revert behavior on failed transfers.
Remove the ownership check so any caller can trigger the transfer.
Remove the zero-address check so transfers to address(0) are attempted.
Remove the positive-amount check so zero-value transfers succeed instead of reverting.
Delete the ownership check so any caller can trigger sendTo.
Delete the zero-address check so transfers to address(0) are allowed.
Delete the positive-amount check so zero-value calls succeed instead of reverting.
Replace require(amount > 0) with require(amount >= 0) so amount == 0 calls no longer revert.
Remove the ownership check so any address can call sendTo.
Remove the zero-address check so transfers to address(0) no longer revert via the require.
Remove the positive-amount check so calls with amount 0 no longer revert.
Always transfer 1 wei instead of the requested amount.
Remove the require(msg.sender == owner) access-control check so any caller can trigger the transfer.
